body:
Added msys*/mingw*/cygwin* OS case, real device enumeration/write via powershell.exe (Get-Disk/Get-Partition/Set-Disk), raw write via .NET FileStream to \\.\PhysicalDriveN. Wired into main write branch via OS-conditional calling new write_raw_image. bash -n and bazel test //:syntax-check pass. Honest: never run on real Windows/hardware this session (headless KVM VM, no USB). Needs founder's own live test. FLASH commit 262a7b8.

⚓ ☃
